Meta.homeTitle: Dalbang · Monthly Rooms & Long Stays in Seoul
Meta.homeDescription: Find a room in Seoul by the month. Share houses, studios and apartments for stays of 30 nights or more — clear prices, English support, request online.
Meta.roomsDescription: Browse share house rooms, studios and apartments for stays of 30+ nights across Seoul.

Demo.banner: Portfolio demo — listings are sample data.

Footer.about: Dalbang (달방) — the Korean way to rent a room by the month.
Footer.demo: This site is a portfolio project. Listings, photos and prices are for demonstration only.

Home.headline: Your home in Seoul, by the month
Home.sub: Rooms in share houses, studios and apartments for stays of 30 nights or more. See the full price upfront and request your dates online.
Home.step1Body: Search by neighborhood, move-in date and budget. Every room shows rent, deposit and fees.
Home.step2Body: Pick your dates (30 nights minimum) and send a booking request. No payment needed.
Home.step3Body: We check your request and reply by email with next steps for moving in.
Home.whatIsBody: In Korean, dal (달) means month and bang (방) means room. A dalbang is a room you rent month to month — no long lease, no Korean bank account needed to start.
